+"""Generate the frozen put_bottles_dustbin trajectory.
+
+The right arm transfers bottle 3 to the left edge of the table. Its sweep
+knocks bottle 2 into the bin. The left arm picks up bottle 3 and drops it in
+the bin. Finally, the right arm drops bottle 1 into the bin from its reachable
+edge. The exact action sequence is verified with open-loop replay.
+"""
+
+from rcb_traj import Session
+
+
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+OUTPUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+
+
+def execute(env, actions):
+    assert env.move(actions) and env.plan_success
+
+
+def right_target(env, x):
+    return [x, -0.13, 1.02] + list(env.robot.get_right_ee_pose()[3:])
+
+
+def main():
+    s = Session("put_bottles_dustbin", instance=INSTANCE)
+    s.reset()
+    env = s.env
+    s.record_start()
+
+    # Bottle 3: right arm brings it to the left edge of the table.
+    execute(env, env.grasp_actor(env.bottles[2], "right", pre_grasp_dis=0.08,
+                                 grasp_dis=0, contact_point_id=5))
+    execute(env, env.move_by_displacement("right", z=0.20))
+    execute(env, env.move_to_pose("right", right_target(env, -0.20)))
+    execute(env, env.open_gripper("right"))
+    execute(env, env.back_to_origin("right"))
+
+    # Preserve the planning queries made when selecting the left grasp.
+    for i in range(8):
+        env.get_grasp_pose(env.bottles[2], "left", i, 0.08)
+
+    execute(env, env.grasp_actor(env.bottles[2], "left", pre_grasp_dis=0.08,
